evidence: PbS was deposited using bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato)lead(II) (Pb(tmhd)2) and 3.5% H2SiN2 as precursors. Al2O3 was deposited using trimethylaluminum (Aldrich) and DI water, and ZnO using diethylzinc (Aldrich) and DI water. Depositions were performed in a customized flow-type ALD reactor with argon carrier gas at 10 sccm.
